# We Know the W build rules

## Photography and real-person imagery

- Do not use AI-rendered, AI-generated, synthetic, or illustrated substitutes for photographs of real players, coaches, executives, or other real people.
- Prefer official league, team, FIBA, tournament, roster, press, licensed, or otherwise editorially appropriate photography.
- Preserve source and rights-holder information where relevant to editorial use.
- This is an internal build requirement. Do not display the rule itself in public-facing page copy, badges, captions, alt text, cards, graphics, or story sections.
- Public copy should describe the basketball and the source when useful, not the production instruction behind the asset choice.
